issues.title: New backend URL to just provide most recent activity
issues.body:
Our backend provides the `logs` end-point for a wargame:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/188853154-6a547d55-35d8-4808-9a07-8e8a8a3c70f3.png)

It return _all_ the player activity for that wargame - which is used by scientists to analyse Serge usage.

This end-point is also used by the `PlayerLog` modal window, to show current/recent player activity.  To do this, it downloads all the logs, then processes them to find the most recent activity for each player.

As the player log grows, this will be a larger and larger data download.  So, IMHO we need a different end-point on the backend:
`/:wargame/:dbname/logs-latest`

This will process the backend data to only have the most recent activity for each user, and return that smaller dataset.
